notes.title: Adaptive Limiter Updated
notes.content:
This update resolves the following issues:
• Audio exported through Adaptive Limiter no longer has an unexpected fade-in
• Adaptive Limiter tooltips are now localized in German, French, Spanish, Japanese, Italian and Russian
• Adaptive Limiter Help no longer fails to launch on Spanish, Italian and Russian systems and opens English help as designed for these systems
• The Adaptive Limiter "Help file does not exist" warning is now localized in in German, French, Spanish, Japanese, Italian and Russian

The following enhancement is also available:
• Right-clicking on the Ceiling or Threshold control will temporarily link both controls together when they are moved

notes.title: L-Phase Series Standalone Plug-ins are now Available!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We recently updated the LP EQ and LP MB previously available in the SONAR Professional & Platinum to standalone products. The branding of these have been slightly adjusted as well and are now called the L-Phase Equalizer and L-Phase Multiband. 

[b]Users will need to download and launch the Authorizer through Steam to finalize installing and activating the plugin.[/b]

These will replace the previous versions and will continue to load in older projects that used the original versions. For SONAR customers who have a current Season or Lifetime pass they will be receiving these into their Steam accounts as new products.

Additionally, we'll be releasing these to a wider audience on Steam in the coming weeks.

[h1]New Features:[/h1][list]
[*] VST2 Support (previously only VST3)
[*] AAX Support[/list]
